popular.name: Budget Planner
popular.description: A spreadsheet filling the tab: planned and actual amounts by category, the difference worked out and totalled.

popular.name: Team Retro
popular.description: Four tabs: a Retro where notes stay hidden until you reveal and vote, the Actions you agree, an Archive of past retros and an Overview dashboard.

popular.name: Bug Tracker
popular.description: Three tabs: Triage new bugs by priority, follow them through Fixing to released, and watch Health on a dashboard.
